title: He closed his eyes, surrendering himself to her, body and mind, conscious of nothing in the world but the dark pressure of her softly parting lips.
html_source: Stephen tried very hard to resist the temptation to be seduced by the woman, but he finally gave in. However, all he really wanted was to be held by the woman. He was afraid of the other things that may come with her (that eventually he surrendered to).
